technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals (StochRSI, Williams %R) conflict with deteriorating momentum (MACD crossover down, CMF negative) and structural weakness (price below all MAs, Ichimoku below cloud, three black crows); insufficient confluence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, lobbying, or retail channels; earnings in 64 days presents timing risk with minimal conviction support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 13) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed/neutral with no conviction from senior members, and absent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (430.88), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and recent CPI event create severe macro headwinds for financials; 64-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall environment is highly adverse.

debate.key_bull_argument: StochRSI cross-up, Williams %R rising, and Supertrend bullish combined with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) create a contrarian oversold bounce setup near support at 40.8949.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, MACD bearish crossover, negative CMF, Ichimoku below thick cloud, three black crows pattern, and severe macro headwinds (VIX 430.88, rising dollar, high credit spreads) indicate structural downtrend with insufficient momentum confluence to justify entry.
